concept: Last-mile crowd delivery connecting women with businesses and distributors.

sources.title: Vanita: Crowd Delivery
sources.observed: Employment opportunity for women, last-mile infrastructure challenges, proposed Indonesian village pilot, Delivery. Done. Money. Earned. Respect. Won.

sources.title: Original app screenshots
sources.observed: Blue Vanita header, All Delivery and My Delivery tabs, accept jobs with distance and weight, accepted job list.

interpretation: Illustrative neighbourhood, fictional route and completion UI. Architecture and animation are contemporary concept art, not a reconstruction of a deployed service. Original source screenshots use Aceh examples.
motion: 28-second deterministic loop: select, collect, carry on spline, turn to doorstep, confirm, fade and restart. No walk back. Real-time animation respects shared pause/reduced-motion behavior.
character: Shared Microsoft Rocketbox authored learner mesh, locally rigged for parcel carrying and walking. MIT license in public/landing/assets/lrnmate-people/.
card: Standard artwork/3D, reset and pause controls, short caption. No custom walkthrough controls.
